user.title: Sign in to Amazon
user.description: Use the account your Amazon devices are registered to in the Alexa app. Your password is used for this sign-in only and is not stored.

data_description.username: The email address of your Amazon account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Amazon again
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon rejected the stored login for {username}. Enter your password; you will be asked for a one-time code next.

otp.title: Enter your one-time code
otp.description: Amazon is asking {username} for a one-time code. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or the one Amazon just sent you.

data_description.code: If the code is rejected, wait for the next one and enter that.

error.invalid_auth: Amazon rejected the email or password.
error.invalid_otp: Amazon rejected that code. Enter the next code from your authenticator app.
error.captcha_required: Amazon asked for a captcha, which Home Assistant cannot show. Sign in once at amazon.com in a browser on the same network, wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.otp_page_missing: Amazon accepted the password but did not ask for a one-time code. Turn on 2-Step Verification (Amazon account, Login & security) and try again. Approve-on-phone prompts are not supported.
error.cannot_retrieve_data: Signed in, but Amazon did not return device data. Try again in a minute.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Amazon account than the one this entry was set up with.
abort.no_supported_devices: Signed in, but this Alexa account has no supported device (Amazon Smart Thermostat or Amazon Smart Plug). Devices found, by category: {summary}. Make sure the device is set up in the Alexa app, then run scripts/discover.py and open an issue with its output.

invalid_auth.message: Amazon rejected the stored login; re-authentication is required.

cannot_retrieve_data.message: Amazon did not return device data: {error}

action_failed.message: Amazon did not accept the command: {error}
